## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -m "not slow"` passes
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` is clean
- [ ] New numerics are tested against a closed form, an identity, or a known
      statistical property - not against previous output
- [ ] Any new lab declares at least five scenarios, including one where the
      method fails
- [ ] Any new animation frame states what you see, what changed, why and how to
      read it
- [ ] Any new proof states what it does **not** establish
- [ ] New user-facing text has keys in all three languages
- [ ] The catalogue still refuses to open what it has not built
